snippet.title: BFDI: Branches - Mobile Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Mobile port news & info: https://bfdibranches.com/
The highly-anticipated mobile port of BFDI: Branches is coming soon!

BFDI: Branches is an all-new platformer game with Firey, Leafy, Coiny, and Pin! Featuring multiple characters with varied gameplay, a story mode with branching paths, a complete level editor, and an online level browser!

BFDI: Branches game link: https://teambranches.itch.io/bfdi-branches
BFDI: Branches website: https://bfdibranches.com/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/muyCChv6Ea 
Twitter: https://x.com/BFDIBranches
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/bfdibranches.com
Subreddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/bfdibranches/
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/TeamBranches
Bandcamp: https://bfdibranches.bandcamp.com/album/bfdi-branches-ost
BFDI: Branches Wiki: https://bfdibranches.wiki.gg

Mobile port developed by Team Snowflakes, supervised by Team Branches

Mobile Trailer Credits:
supersonico - Director, Editor, Player
PHOBOS - Animator, Storyboarder
mationsBOMB - Animator
TheGabiM - Music
Barfy - Logo

BFDI and Assets are created by Jacknjellify
